raw_definitions: Definisi : 2. covered with woods, berhutan kecil: we went for a walk in the ~ valley, kami pergi bersiar-siar di lembah yg berhutan kecil. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : adj 1. having hard stem, berkayu: ~ plants are difficult to cut, tumbuh-tumbuhan berkayu sukar dipotong; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
